definitions.explanation: The measurable quantity of a specific substance present within something, used in scientific, nutritional, and industrial contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{鉄分|てつぶん}→鉄分：19444_tetsubun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{含有量|がんゆうりょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{食品|しょくひん}→食品：03247_shokuhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦カルシウム→カルシウム：10963_karushiumu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{含有量|がんゆうりょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: This food has a high calcium content.

examples.japanese: ⟦{水質|すいしつ}→水質：22420_suishitsu⟧⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{有害|ゆうがい}{物質|ぶっしつ}→有害物質：22132_yuugaibusshitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{含有量|がんゆうりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べた→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧。
examples.english: We checked the content of harmful substances in the water quality test.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{含有|がんゆう}→含有：20105_ganyuu⟧ (containing, inclusion) and ⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧ (amount, quantity). Used in scientific, nutritional, and industrial contexts to express how much of a particular substance is contained in something.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {含有量|がんゆうりょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧: high content
- {含有量|がんゆうりょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧: low content
- {含有量|がんゆうりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{測定|そくてい}→測定：04398_sokutei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to measure the content
- {含有量|がんゆうりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧: to check the content
- ⟦{栄養素|えいようそ}→栄養素：06207_eiyouso⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{含有量|がんゆうりょう}: nutrient content

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {含有率|がんゆうりつ}: content ratio — expressed as a percentage rather than an absolute amount
- ⟦{成分|せいぶん}→成分：04344_seibun⟧: ingredient, component — refers to the substance itself rather than its quantity
- ⟦{濃度|のうど}→濃度：00325_noudo⟧: concentration — the amount of a substance per unit volume of solution
